notes: DRAFT text for L8-SPEC.md (sections 1, 3 and 4). Drops into the seal-families.json shape: family id, name, text, ranks (technique, name, text). The group names 'Lock (arm)' and 'Lock (wrist)' are PLACEHOLDERS until Jay names the groups; ids never change, so a rename is text only. Every kid line is 8 words or fewer, one sentence, and names no body targets. Rank names are the J27 real-name list where one exists; OPEN ones wait on Jay. No line promises a number the spec dropped (no extra hold time, no push, no Focus).
